namespace PubDC05

def modCong (m a b : Nat) : Prop := a % m = b % m

theorem modCong_equiv (m a b c : Nat) :
    (modCong m a b → modCong m b a) ∧ (modCong m a b → modCong m b c → modCong m a c) := by
  unfold modCong
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h; exact h.symm
  · intro h1 h2; exact Eq.trans h1 h2

end PubDC05
